name: Armory of Sunnyglade
summary: Someone asks you to recover a blacksmithing tome from Sunnyglade in the Riverglades. Its title ties it to the Tremayne family.

sections.title: A Family Tome
sections.body: In Sunnyglade, within the Riverglades, you are asked to recover a book on the Tremayne family's blacksmithing techniques. The request centers on the tome itself; its whereabouts in Sunnyglade remain the matter at hand.

faq.answer: You are looking for the tome of Tremayne Family Blacksmithing Techniques.
The tome is sought in Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades.
The title identifies the blacksmithing techniques with the Tremayne family.

attribution: In-game quest text: Armory of Sunnyglade
